description: This file defines the ServerRequestFactory class that implements the ServerRequestFactoryInterface to create PSR-7 server request objects, primarily used for handling HTTP server requests within a Guzzle-based PHP project.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating PSR-7 server request objects, implementing the ServerRequestFactoryInterface.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ServerRequest instance using the specified HTTP method, URI, and server parameters. If the method is not provided, it attempts to retrieve it from server parameters.
